slides.title: The Town
slides.text: A viral outbreak has affected a small industrial town, causing psychological disorders and hallucinations among its residents. The government has introduced mandatory medical treatment to contain the disease.

slides.title: The Blockade
slides.text: To prevent the infection from spreading, the authorities have placed the town under indefinite quarantine. All access routes are sealed, and essential supplies are distributed under government supervision.

slides.title: The Curfew
slides.text: For public safety, a strict nighttime curfew has been imposed. Military patrols maintain order, and citizens are required to remain indoors after sunset. All restrictions will remain in force until the situation is stabilized.
